days.description: how long the banner shows, default 7

tenants_on_platform_number.description:
Unbilled lists tenants with credit movement but no WhatsApp row, which send from the
platform's number; their Meta cost is inside the platform number's row.

meta_cost_kes.description:
MetaCostKES is Meta's cost converted with treasury's rate, and MarginKES the credits value
less it. Both are unset when the rate is unavailable or Meta's side could not be read.

note.description: Note explains a row that needs it in plain words.

tenant.description:
Tenant is the slug, "platform" for the platform's own number, or "unassigned" for a number
no row claims.

whole_account.description: WholeAccount marks the row holding a WABA's total when Meta did not split it by number.

error.description: Error is Meta's refusal or a missing token; the rest of the report still renders.

kes_per_unit.description: KESPerUnit is treasury's rate for Currency; RateUnavailable is set when none could be read.

display_name.description:
DisplayName is Meta's verified_name, NameStatus its review state (APPROVED, PENDING_REVIEW,
DECLINED, AVAILABLE_WITHOUT_REVIEW, EXPIRED, NONE).

new_display_name.description: NewDisplayName and NewNameStatus describe a requested name change still being reviewed.

quality_rating.description: QualityRating is GREEN, YELLOW, RED, or NA/UNKNOWN for a number with too little traffic.

detail.description: Meta's error message, when Outcome is "failed"

meta_reason.description:
MetaReason is Meta's rejected_reason for a REJECTED template (e.g. INVALID_FORMAT,
TAG_CONTENT_MISMATCH), so admins know what to change before submitting a new version.

meta_status.description:
MetaStatus is Meta's review status for a template that already exists (APPROVED, PENDING,
REJECTED, ...), so admins can see whether a submitted template can be sent yet.

status.description:
Status is Meta's review status (APPROVED, PENDING, REJECTED, PAUSED, DISABLED ...), or
MISSING when the template has not been submitted to this WABA.

prefixes.description: required — refuses to run with none, see Delete

deregistered.description: Deregistered is true when Meta released the number from Cloud API.

notes.description: Notes explain any Meta step that could not be done, e.g. an account already deleted.

unsubscribed.description: Unsubscribed is true when our app stopped receiving the account's webhooks.

filled.description: Filled lists the fields set from the branding ("about", "email", "photo" ...).

warnings.description: Warnings explain what could not be used (an SVG logo, a too long tagline ...).

batch_size.description:
BatchSize caps how many templates one call submits (default 5, at most 10); the rest come
back queued and the caller calls again until remaining is 0.

names.description:
Names limits the run to these exact template names: the UI's submit queue sends one batch
of names per call, so a template Meta refused is not retried by every later batch.

only.description: name prefixes, e.g. ["finance_"] — empty means every template

to.description: Email or phone for test message

bearerAuth.description: JWT token from auth-service. Format: Bearer {token}
bearerAuth.name: Authorization
